message: 流星ＡＦ

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, you two\s04」

name: Sally
message: 「Ah, it's the Principal! Heyaaa」

name: Helena
message: 「Sally-chan, heya!」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena... san?」

name: Sally
message: 「Principal, what are you doing in a place like this?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Not a line a flat-chested runt who tagged along with Lord Synn on her own gets to say」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you floating around like Sally-chan?」

name: Sally
message: 「Ufufunofu, it's obviously 'cause she admires me! Sally-chan is the idol of the Demon World, after all~♪」

name: Helena
message: 「That's right, just once, I wanted to enjoy a stroll through the sky like Sally-chan」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I get that. It's a childish dream, but I'd love to fly freely through the sky myself too」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah! No, wait! I didn't mean you're immature, Helena-san!」

name: Helena
message: 「Kuhhaa! So close, Synn-chan!!」

name: Helena
message: 「That's where you're supposed to hit on me by saying I'm a wonderful woman who never loses her pure, childlike heart no matter how old she gets... right?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I-I-I don't have the guts to woo you, Helena-san」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu, I'll have you steel your nerves in a different way, okay? If the Crusaders end up in a tight spot down the road, you're going to be the one flying」

name: Sally
message: 「Hmm... hmmm? Aha, I got it! The Principal is hanging from balloons!」

name: Helena
message: 「Ding-dong♪ Bullseye~. I'll give you a daifuku mochi as a prize. Here, go ahead and scarf it down」

name: Sally
message: 「Yay♪ I love you, Principal~\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Sally-chan, what do you mean by balloons?」
Looking closely, several thin wires extend into the sky from both of Helena-san's shoulders.

name: Sally
message: 「Look, look, right over there」
At the ends of the wires, balloons were indeed floating.

name: Helena
message: 「A leisurely, floaty stroll in the sky is fun too, but this is a reverse bungee, you know?」

name: Sally
message: 「What is that, what is that? Looks fun!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Riesling Tohyama to Helena. Do you read me? Over」

name: Helena
message: 「Loud and clear, Tamiko-chan. Over」

name: Riesling
message: 「Passing turning point 4. Ojou-sama Copter course locked」

name: Riesling
message: 「Commencing emergency extraction test now. Are you prepared? Over」

name: Helena
message: 「Ready whenever♪ Over」

name: Riesling
message: 「Understood. Leave the piloting of the Ojou-sama Copter to me, your butler Riesling Tohyama. Over」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha―what the...!? A helicopter's coming in at breakneck speed from offshore―」

name: Riesling
message: 「No, it is the Ojou-sama Copter. Please do not mistake it. Over」

name: Sally
message: 「Awawawawa, the Great Oyabin of Tontoro is flying over!」
A pink dot appears in the sky above the horizon.
The dot rapidly swells into a familiar shape... taking on the form of Tontoro, though its size is on a completely different scale.
Propellers spin at high speed on its back, seemingly based on aerodynamics, at least in theory.

name: Paqy
message: 「What a waste of technology」

name: Helena
message: 「Here it comes, here it comes, here it cooooooooomes!」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, I'm off! Synn-chan, don't peek up my skirt from below, okay?\s04」

name: Helena
message: 「YahoOOOO♪ This is the beeeeest\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh... Whaaaaaaaat!?」
A Y-shaped pole like a man-catcher extends from the giant Tontoro's snout, hooks onto the wire, and flies off.

name: Sally
message: 「It's flying off toward the school」

name: Sally
message: 「No fair, no fair, that looks so fun! Let me join in too, Chairwoman!」
In the distant sky, the giant Tontoro shrinks out of sight in the blink of an eye.
Before long, a hatch on its rear opens to reel in the dangling Helena-san, and the silhouette of the Ojou-sama Copter vanishes completely beyond the horizon.

name: Synn
message: 「Ehhh?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nothing to gawk over. That's just standard military stuff」

name: Paqy
message: 「When they extract spies or operatives sent into enemy territory from the air, they do it just like that」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Right……」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!? Don't tell me……」

name: Synn
message: 「If we get surrounded by Demons up ahead and end up in a desperate pinch, you're telling me to pull that off and run!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「The great me wants to give it a shot」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way! Something like that is way too scary, no way in hell--!!」
Under the wide sky, clear as if nothing had happened, my shriek echoes out in vain.
